text: You're 18, and the money is yours now. What kind of person are you with money?

right.label: You only live once
right.result: You will live once, and in overdraft.

up.label: Put it all on a market stall

risk.result: The stall takes off. You are, briefly, a businessperson.

text: Your first election. The polling station is a school hall that smells of floor polish.

right.label: Go and vote
right.result: You get a sticker. You keep the sticker.

up.label: Stand for the student council

risk.result: You lose to a boy who promised free pizza.

text: Everything you own has turned pink.

up.label: Start a pink clothes brand

risk.result: Three influencers wear it. Sales are brisk.

text: You're renting now. A parent calls to ask if you're eating vegetables.

right.label: Lie warmly
right.result: A potato is a vegetable.

up.label: Invite them for Sunday lunch

risk.result: They critique the flat, the food and your posture.

text: Your flatmate's dishes have been in the sink for nine days. Something is growing.

right.label: Leave a note
right.result: The reply note is longer than yours.

up.label: Throw a dish-burning party

risk.result: The fire brigade is not impressed. Neither is the landlord.

text: The landlord wants to keep your deposit for a mark that was already there.

risk.result: He keeps it anyway.

up.label: Post the whole saga online

risk.result: The landlord's solicitor writes back. In capital letters.

text: There's mould behind the wardrobe, and you've been breathing it for a while.

right.label: Fight the landlord
right.result: He sends a man with a tin of paint.

up.label: Move out tonight and sue

risk.result: Lawyers cost more than mould.

text: You're still in your childhood bedroom. The glow stars still glow.

right.label: Start looking at flats
right.result: You see the prices. You look at the stars.

up.label: Go and live in a van

risk.result: January in a van is not a lifestyle choice.

text: The interviewer asks where you see yourself in five years.

right.label: Tell the truth
right.result: "Asleep." They laugh. You weren't joking.

up.label: Pitch your own idea for the role

risk.result: They thank you. Nobody ever calls.

text: The application wants experience you don't have. It's only one little line.

risk.result: They ask you about it. In detail.

up.label: Start your own company instead

risk.result: It turns out invoices are a lot of work.

text: A stranger online can double your money. There are testimonials and a very nice logo.

risk.result: Then it went a bit wrong.
The nice logo is gone. So is the $500.

up.label: Go to their office and ask questions

risk.result: The office is a van. The van is leaving fast.

text: A shop assistant offers you a store card. Ten percent off today!

right.label: Ten percent!
right.result: You saved $120 by spending $1,200.

up.label: Haggle for the whole shop

risk.result: There is a queue. The queue has opinions.

text: The old car dies at a junction. Everyone behind you has an opinion.

risk.result: It dies again on the way home.

up.label: Sell it to the lad behind you

risk.result: He wanted it for parts. Now you are the villain.

text: You've had a few, and your car is right there. It's only ten minutes.

risk.result: Blue lights in the mirror. A fine and a very long night.

up.label: Walk home along the river

risk.result: You lost your phone. And a shoe.

death.cause: The river was colder and deeper than it looked.

text: Someone in the club toilets offers you a small bag. "You'll love it."

right.label: Take it

risk.result: You spend the next day in the ER with a very bored nurse.

right.result: Two good hours. Then a very bad Tuesday.

up.label: Report them to the bouncers

risk.result: They know your face now. Every weekend.

text: Your head is a bass drum, and work starts in forty minutes.

right.label: Go in anyway
right.result: You nod through a meeting. You agreed to something.

up.label: Pitch the boss a four-day week

risk.result: The boss writes your name down. Not kindly.

text: A gym offers you a year's membership. You feel a new you coming on.

risk.result: You go twice. It bills you twelve times.

up.label: Train for a triathlon

risk.result: Your knee files a complaint at mile two.

text: You've eaten instant noodles for eleven days in a row.

right.label: Learn to cook one thing
right.result: It's a chilli. It's always going to be a chilli.

up.label: Apply for a restaurant kitchen job

risk.result: The chef throws a pan. At you.

text: You've got a mole that looks different from how you remember it.

risk.result: You should have gone. It comes off, later than it should.

right.label: See a doctor
right.result: It's nothing. You're allowed to breathe.

up.label: Get it removed this afternoon

risk.result: The scar is bigger than the mole was.

death.cause: It was more than a mole, and it was found too late.

text: You've been tired for months. You cried at a bus timetable.

right.label: Talk to someone
right.result: Saying it out loud helps more than you'd planned for.

up.label: Book a one-way ticket and vanish

risk.result: The job you left is not waiting. Nor is the flat.

text: The group chat from school has gone quiet. It's been four months.

right.label: Organise a night out
right.result: Everyone has the same jokes and new jobs.

up.label: Move in with them all

risk.result: Nine people, one bathroom. It ends badly.

text: A friend asks to borrow $1,000. They swear it's only until Friday.

risk.result: It has been many Fridays.

up.label: Go into business with them

risk.result: The business works. You bought a round.

text: Someone your age is getting married. Already. The gift list starts at $150.

up.label: Propose to your own date there

risk.result: They say no. In front of the whole room.

text: Your friends are going travelling for a year. There's a spare bunk.

right.label: Go
right.result: You come back with a bracelet and opinions about rice.

up.label: Move there and don't come back

risk.result: You are ill, broke and learning the language.

text: It's 1am, and the tattoo place is open. Your friend knows a guy.

risk.result: It's spelled wrong. It's your own name.

up.label: Start your own tattoo studio

risk.result: There is a queue out the door.

text: You could sell stuff online at weekends. Everyone says it's easy.

risk.result: You now own 400 phone cases.

up.label: Quit your job for it. Full-time.

risk.result: The market was fond of you for about a month.

text: A brown envelope from the tax office. Nothing good has ever come in brown.

risk.result: The second envelope is red.

right.label: Open it
right.result: You're owed $14.

up.label: Hire an accountant and dispute it all

risk.result: The accountant bills by the minute. So does the tax office.

text: Someone from your school just bought a house. You just bought a slightly nicer sponge.

risk.result: Not everything went your way.

right.label: Keep scrolling
right.result: It's 3am. You know the layout of their kitchen.

up.label: Buy a one-way ticket to anywhere

risk.result: Anywhere turns out to be quite expensive.

text: The food bank down the road is short of hands on Saturdays.

up.label: Open your own kitchen at weekends

risk.result: The food bill does not feed itself.

text: Your grandparent wants help with their phone. Again. It's the same button.

right.label: Go round
right.result: Twenty seconds on the phone. Three hours of stories and cake.

up.label: Get them a smart speaker and a tablet

risk.result: They now call you at 3am to ask what Alexa is.

text: A pigeon has walked into your flat, and it seems to think it's paying rent.

right.label: Name it Gerald
right.result: Gerald brings friends.

up.label: Start a pigeon rescue

risk.result: The neighbours call it a pigeon problem.

text: A form asks for your "next of kin". You have to look up what that means.

right.label: Write your best friend

risk.result: You paid for it later.

right.result: You text them. They're delighted and slightly scared.

up.label: Write your own name. Be your own next of kin.

risk.result: The clerk's face tells you what they think.
